name: CISOfy/lynis
description: Security auditing tool for Linux, macOS, and UNIX-based systems that assists with compliance testing against HIPAA, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS standards and provides system hardening recommendations. Agentless with optional installation.
score_rationale: Industry-standard Unix security auditing tool with 15.4k stars, actively maintained through October 2025, and widely used for compliance validation across major security standards.
summary: Security auditing tool for Linux, macOS, and UNIX-based systems that assists with compliance testing
